description: This Java source file defines the NormalDistribution class, implementing the normal (Gaussian) distribution with methods for density, cumulative probability, inverse cumulative, and sampling. It extends AbstractRealDistribution and provides properties like mean and standard deviation.

classes.name: NormalDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the normal (Gaussian) distribution in the Apache Commons Math library, providing density, cumulative probability, inverse, and sampling methods for the distribution.

methods.name: getMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getStandardDeviation
methods.description: Returns the standard deviation of the distribution.

methods.name: density
methods.description: Calculates the probability density function value at a given point.

methods.name: logDensity
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the density at a given point.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the cumulative distribution function value at a point.

methods.name: inverseCumulativeProbability
methods.description: Computes the inverse of the cumulative distribution function for a given probability.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability that a value falls between two points.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution (same as getMean).

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution's support (negative infinity).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution's support (positive infinity).

methods.name: isSupportLowerBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the lower support bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportUpperBoundInclusive
methods.description: Indicates whether the upper support bound is inclusive (false).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support is connected (true).

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Generates a sample from the distribution.
